To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the UNICT-Fd889 dataset is the first food images dataset that is large enough for studying representation models, and (2) the Bag of Texton representation obtained considering the RGB color space is the best descriptor for food NDIR.

(1) the UNICT-FDA89 dataset is the first food dataset composed by 889 images of food; (2) the Bag of Texton descriptor, considering the color domain, is the best representation model for NDIR on the UNICT-FDD889 dataset.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a benchmark dataset for food images.
a fundamental step in the food recognition chain, i.e. the image representation.
1) the introduction of a novel food dataset to study the food representation; 2) the comparison of different image representation models for food recognition.

the UNICT-FDA dataset can be used for studying the food image representation, as well as for the food image retrieval.
